d: Short, swept-up sandy blonde hair with a side-parted fringe frames a youthful, mature face with sharp, narrow golden eyes. The slender build is dressed in a white military-style outfit consisting of a high-collared jacket, matching trousers, a black belt, and black boots, topped with a voluminous white and crimson dual-layered cape featuring a white rose ornament on the chest. A large, ornate silver and red spear is held in one hand.
